questions.q: What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?
questions.why: It is on the south coast.

questions.q: From which country did Papua New Guinea gain independence in 1975?
questions.why: It is in the Commonwealth.

questions.q: About how many languages are spoken in Papua New Guinea?
questions.why: It has more languages than any other country.

questions.q: What is Papua New Guinea's currency?
questions.why: It is named after a shell once used as money.

questions.q: Which island does Papua New Guinea share with Indonesia?
questions.why: It is the world's second-largest island.

questions.q: Which bird appears on Papua New Guinea's flag?
questions.why: It is the national bird.

questions.q: Which creole language is widely spoken in Papua New Guinea?
questions.why: It is one of the official languages.

questions.q: Who was Papua New Guinea's first Prime Minister?
questions.why: He is called the father of the nation.

questions.q: Who has been Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea since 2019?
questions.why: He is from the Highlands.

questions.q: Which island region voted for independence from Papua New Guinea in 2019?
questions.why: Almost 98% voted to leave.

questions.q: Which Second World War track saw Australians fight the Japanese?
questions.why: It crosses the Owen Stanley Range.

questions.q: Which Highlands valley was unknown to outsiders until the 1930s?
questions.why: About a million people lived there.

questions.q: Which copper mine on Bougainville sparked a civil war?
questions.why: It closed in 1989.

questions.q: Which country ruled the north of the island before the First World War?
questions.why: It was called Kaiser-Wilhelmsland.

questions.q: Which island became a detention centre for Australian asylum seekers?
questions.why: It closed in 2017.

questions.q: Which festival in the Highlands brings together many tribes?
questions.why: Mount Hagen holds a similar show.

questions.q: Which big river is famous for its carved spirit houses?
questions.why: It is about 1,100 km long.

questions.q: Which large flightless bird lives in Papua New Guinea's forests?
questions.why: It can be dangerous.

questions.q: Which sport is the national sport of Papua New Guinea?
questions.why: The State of Origin series is hugely popular.

questions.q: Which earth-oven feast is cooked with hot stones?
questions.why: Pork and sweet potato are cooked in it.

questions.q: Which people paint skeletons on their bodies in the Highlands?
questions.why: They perform at festivals.

questions.q: Which mud-masked people come from the Asaro Valley?
questions.why: Legend says they scared off enemies.

questions.q: Which people make wigs from their own hair?
questions.why: They live in Hela Province.

questions.q: Which Highlands peak is Papua New Guinea's highest?
questions.why: It is about 4,510 m high.

questions.q: Which islands have a famous yam festival and cricket game?
questions.why: Their cricket has dancing and chanting.

questions.q: Which coffee is a major export from the Highlands?
questions.why: It is grown on small farms.

questions.q: Which crocodile-scarification ritual is a Sepik tradition?
questions.why: It marks boys becoming men.

questions.q: Which volcano destroyed Rabaul in 1994?
questions.why: Rabaul's town was mostly buried in ash.

questions.q: Which shell money is still used in parts of New Britain?
questions.why: It is made from small shells.

questions.q: Which canoe and drum festival is held in Alotau?
questions.why: It is held each November.
